locked_forecasts.label: Sustained major regional escalation
locked_forecasts.event_definition: Sustained major interstate strikes lasting at least 72 hours, or a material expansion of major combat to an additional sovereign state or operational theater. Isolated interceptions, one-off strikes, proxy attacks, and rhetoric alone are excluded unless they initiate the qualifying sustained episode.
locked_forecasts.raise: More sustained Saudi/Houthi attacks, actual new-state engagement or US-Iran interstate strikes.
locked_forecasts.lower: Verified Saudi-Houthi de-escalation, an agreed Hormuz reopening or reliable US-Iran ceasefire.
locked_forecasts.provenance: Prospective frozen Protocol v1.0 draft formed after actual evidence cutoff; NOT ISSUED unless validated and independently approved.

locked_forecasts.label: Regime-ending transition
locked_forecasts.event_definition: Replacement of the Islamic Republic's governing constitutional-institutional order, or loss of its effective national governing authority. Leadership succession, cabinet changes, and factional turnover within the same governing order are excluded.
locked_forecasts.raise: Security force defections, national fiscal payment failure or rival sovereign authority.
locked_forecasts.lower: Demonstrated elite cohesion, functioning priority payments and broad stabilization.
locked_forecasts.provenance: Prospective frozen Protocol v1.0 draft formed after actual evidence cutoff; NOT ISSUED unless validated and independently approved.

locked_forecasts.label: Currency crisis
locked_forecasts.event_definition: Depreciation of the parallel-market rial by at least 25% against the U.S. dollar over any rolling 30-calendar-day window, using the designated consistent parallel-rate series and excluding a single-day quote anomaly that reverses within 48 hours.
locked_forecasts.raise: A consistently measured rapid parallel-rial depreciation and exhaustion of credible support mechanisms.
locked_forecasts.lower: Sustained parallel-market stability and restored external settlements.
locked_forecasts.provenance: Prospective frozen Protocol v1.0 draft formed after actual evidence cutoff; NOT ISSUED unless validated and independently approved.

locked_forecasts.label: External-payments crisis
locked_forecasts.event_definition: Corroborated settlement disruption lasting at least 14 days in at least two essential-import categories—food or grain, medicine or medical inputs, or critical energy or industrial inputs—combined with broad emergency foreign-exchange, import, or payment restrictions or a material shift by suppliers to prepayment or cash because established settlement channels are failing. Evidence must come from at least two independent source streams.
locked_forecasts.raise: Corroborated two-category essential-import settlement disruption lasting two weeks and emergency restrictions.
locked_forecasts.lower: Sustained verified essential-import payments through multiple functional channels.
locked_forecasts.provenance: Prospective frozen Protocol v1.0 draft formed after actual evidence cutoff; NOT ISSUED unless validated and independently approved.
